name: Eyebite

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a creature you can see within 60 feet of you

summary: Each turn, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save or falls asleep, panics or sickens.
text: Asleep: Unconscious until damaged or shaken awake; Panicked: Frightened and Dashing away from you; Sickened: Poisoned, with a new save at the end of each of its turns. Later turns: a Magic action picks a new target, never one that already saved.
